semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in wet process equipment and auxiliary wet cleaning equipment for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Anhui Wanweikelin Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. is a semiconductor equipment manufacturer based in Hefei, Anhui Province. The company focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of wet process and auxiliary wet cleaning equipment, serving the integrated circuits, microelectronics, and artificial intelligence sectors. With a robust patent portfolio and a seasoned technical team, it provides essential plant support equipment tailored to semiconductor manufacturing needs.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Hefei, Anhui Province, and has established a sales network across more than 20 cities.
